subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR wait for real full-runner or gateway proof before merge, or can maintainers accept the current temporary-script and fault-injected test proof for this retry/session-state change?
rationale: The code shape looks correct, but the remaining blocker is proof sufficiency and maintainer acceptance of compatibility-sensitive retry semantics, which automation cannot safely decide from tests alone.

options.title: Require real retry proof
options.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway logs/output showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool or message side effects before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the temporary-script and fault-injected evidence and own the remaining runtime proof risk.

options.title: Pause for canonical selection
options.body: If maintainers prefer another open candidate for the same issue, pause this PR while choosing one canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Require real retry proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted full-runner or gateway logs/output showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool or message side effects before merge.
